rule: Sliding 90 s windows (1 s step) over the corridor-02 header clock, kept if max pose gap <= 605 ms (drops the 706/807/908 ms holes), max LiDAR gap <= 250 ms, path >= 40 m and accumulated |yaw| >= 60 deg (straight travel plus turns, so both mounting and timing errors are observable); ranked by fewest pose gaps > 500 ms, then > 350 ms, then smallest max gap, then longest path. Images: nearest frame to targets spaced 4.5 s apart (first at +2 s), kept only if a LiDAR scan is within 60 ms and the bracketing pose gap is <= 450 ms.
supersedes: v0 (window at +15 s, rejected: contained the 908 ms pose hole and only 10 m of path)

window.note: selection start/end seconds are shifted by -0.5 ms so the float-seconds bounds fall between observations

pose_source.format: TUM order: t x y z qx qy qz qw (t in the corridor-02 header clock, seconds)
pose_source.note: The SequenceArtifact holds 0 external_pose observations; the pose stream must come from this side file.

alternative_static_control_window.note: Gap-free but almost stationary (8 m in 90 s); usable only as a determinism/clean-gap control.
